messages:
sophie_sales: Heads-up, major exec escalation for Arctic Robotics POC. CTO wants signoff today or we lose the slot. They hit three blockers: BYO-KMS attestation, VPC peering throughput <> 10Gbps, and firm latency SLO for <100ms tail. Need a clear yes/no + mitigation plan before 3pm PT. :rotating_light:
omar_solutions: On BYO-KMS — we can support customer-managed keys but they asked for HSM attestation report. @maya_security can we provide a short attestation checklist or an interim company letter?
liam_eng_runtime: For latency/SLO, we can offer a Dedicated pool with p99 guidance. I can run a quick perf sim with their load profile if they share sample traces (or seq length dist). Could have numbers in ~2 hours.
maya_security: We can provide SOC2 summary + KMS integration notes. HSM attestation is not standard in our hosted path; for Private deployments we have an HSM flow and certs. If Arctic insists, we need to scope Private or dedicated BYO-HSM runbook. I can draft an interim attestation letter but need legal signoff.
elena_pm: Timeline: Sophie — customer call at 15:30 PT (12 hours). They want an exec present for signoff. Can someone from eng or security join? Also need a one-pager with blockers, mitigations, and delta pricing.
sophie_sales: @jordan_salesops can you sketch the pricing delta for Dedicated + BYO-KMS add-on? We need a number we can commit to on the call (ballpark is fine).
jordan_salesops: I’ll run a quick model — give me the expected qps and token rate. If we offer Dedicated + BYO-KMS (private key handling fee) + peering bandwidth, I can produce a 3-tier pricing in 30m.
liam_eng_runtime: Quick ask for perf sim: can Arctic share 1) average seq length, 2) qps during peak, 3) typical batch size? If they can’t, I’ll use conservative defaults but that ups cost.
sophie_sales: I just asked @CTO_Arctic in the email thread for load profile; pinged them to attach before the call.
omar_solutions: Short mitigation for peering: offer temporary routed peering through our EU region with 10Gbps burst and limit rules, while eng runs a point-to-point test. That buys ~48 hours.
maya_security: Legal: I’ll start a PR to legal for an attestation letter. If we do Private deployment, we need procurement lead time. For hosted + BYO-KMS we can offer key import flow + logs but no HSM attestation.
elena_pm: Action items: 1) Jordan — pricing delta in 30m. 2) Liam — perf sim and p99 guidance in ~2h. 3) Maya — attestation letter draft + legal ping. 4) Omar — temporary peering mitigation doc. Sophie will lead the call and needs an exec.
sophie_sales: Can an Eng lead or VP join the 15:30 call? @liam_eng_runtime @omar_solutions @elena_pm please flag if you can escalate for an exec cover.
liam_eng_runtime: I can join but need an ops/infra exec backup — I’ll ping @cto_oncall for presence.
omar_solutions: I can join the customer call and cover solution architecture.
jordan_salesops: Pricing deck uploaded to the thread: https://redwood.internal/sales/decks/arctic-dedicated-delta-v1.pdf — ballpark numbers in there.
sophie_sales: Great — I’ll consolidate and send the 1-pager. Thanks team. If we get the attestation + perf numbers we can commit to the slot. :thumbsup:
